## Data Source

Data provided by the [palmerpenguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/) package (CC0 License).

```{python}
#| label: python-setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from palmerpenguins import load_penguins

penguins = load_penguins()
```

## Data Cleaning

```{python}
#| label: python-clean
# Computational Chunk 1: Clean missing values for plotting
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g', 'species'])

```

## Penguins Body Mass By Species

```{python}
#| label: fig-penguin-mass
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of penguin body mass by species."
# Computational Chunk 2: Create boxplot visualization
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")
sns.boxplot(data=penguins_clean, x="species", y="body_mass_g", palette="Set2")
plt.title("Body Mass Distribution Across Penguin Species")
plt.xlabel("Species")
plt.ylabel("Body Mass (g)")
plt.show()
```

## Physical Measurement Summary

```{python}
#| label: tbl-penguin-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Mean physical measurements by penguin species."
# Computational Chunk 3: Compute summary table
penguins_clean.groupby("species")[["bill_length_mm", "bill_depth_mm", "flipper_length_mm", "body_mass_g"]].mean()
```
